description: Session 6 sector-conditioned per-destination net recurrent-current decomposition, split by TT/TR/RT/RR and recurrent-weight sign after excluding reset t=0 frames.
notes: Every selected frame computes the instantaneous recurrent product g_ij(t) * W_ij * h_j(t-1), rather than multiplying separately averaged gate and activity terms.
TT/TR/RT/RR are sector-context-specific and each positive/negative/total contribution is divided by its destination-unit count.
The gate component uses the equal-weight cross-sector mean gate while retaining actual h_j(t-1); it is not a frozen-gate counterfactual.
Supplementary 4 renders sector-wise I, ΔI, and gate-only contributions with seed mean ± SEM.

Initial session created no seed outputs: set -u conflicted with the remote Conda activation hook. Recovery r2 retained the same empty result leaf and removed that shell option, but its runner omitted collector --seed. Recovery r3 added --seed but exposed a stale digit-count constant. Recovery r4 derives the context count directly from the sector masks.
